vitals.title: Process overview band
vitals.desc: Automatic mode collapses the overview when space is short and reserves 10 rows.

visibility.title: System process hiding rules
visibility.desc: Choose programs to always show or hide together.

userGroups.title: Group processes by user
userGroups.desc: Groups processes by user. Automatic applies only with two or more users.

holdOrder.title: Pause sorting while hovering
holdOrder.desc: While the pointer is over the list, rows keep their place and readings update.

language.title: Display language
language.desc: Applies at once. “Same as Windows” follows the Windows display language.

theme.title: Theme
theme.desc: “Same as Windows” follows the Windows app mode and switches with it.

navigation.title: Navigation position
navigation.desc: The ☰ button expands the side pane; top navigation shows page tabs.

autostart.title: Start when signing in to Windows
autostart.desc: Starts quietly in the system tray. Open the window with the keyboard shortcut or by clicking the tray icon.

startPage.title: Default page
startPage.desc: The page shown when the window first opens after GoodGood starts.

trayPage.title: Reopen from tray
trayPage.desc: Applies when reopening through the tray or a shortcut. Restoring a minimized window keeps the current page.

closeToTray.title: Keep in the system tray when closed
closeToTray.desc: Keeps GoodGood running so it reopens quickly; history and rules keep working.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.desc: View shortcuts for navigation, pausing updates, process actions and more.
shortcuts.scope: Everyday actions, navigation and list shortcuts.
shortcuts.globalHint: Current setting. Also works while using other apps.
shortcuts.inputHint: In-app shortcuts do not affect other apps.
shortcuts.search: Go to process search. The / key also works when not typing.
shortcuts.runTask: Start a program or open a file or folder from any page. Not while typing.
shortcuts.pause: Pauses updates while held and resumes when released.
shortcuts.end: End the selected process or app group, with confirmation.
shortcuts.taskManager: Open GoodGood when Task Manager replacement is enabled.
shortcuts.expand: Processes: collapse / expand a group or category, or select a parent / child
shortcuts.endTable: Processes: end the selection, with confirmation
shortcuts.endDirect: Processes: end the selection without confirmation
shortcuts.clear: Clear selection; clear the process search first if one is active.
shortcuts.history: When the history chart has focus
shortcuts.time: Select the previous / next point in time
shortcuts.timeJump: Move backward / forward by a larger amount
shortcuts.timeEnds: Select the earliest / latest point in time
shortcuts.latest: Clear the time selection and return to the latest data

hotkey.title: Show or hide GoodGood
hotkey.desc: Works in most programs. Usually a modifier plus one ordinary key.
hotkey.help: Press and release a key combination to save it. Esc cancels; Backspace turns the shortcut off.

done.off: The shortcut is turned off. The combination is kept; turn it back on with the switch.

hint.order: Hold the modifiers (Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win) first, then press the other key.
hint.multipleKeys: Only one ordinary key can be used.
hint.lockKey: Caps Lock, Num Lock and Scroll Lock aren't part of a combination and are ignored.
hint.maybeTaken: If nothing happens after pressing a combination, Windows or another app may be using it.

warning.common: {shortcut} has its own use in many apps; as a global shortcut it stops working there.
warning.inApp: {shortcut} is used by a GoodGood feature; a global shortcut stops that feature.
warning.imeSwitch: Ctrl+Space usually switches the input method; a global shortcut stops that.
warning.numpad: Keypad digits and the decimal point trigger the shortcut only while Num Lock is on.
warning.printScreen: {shortcut} may conflict with the Windows screenshot or a screenshot app.

error.invalid: {shortcut} can't be used as a shortcut: {reason}
error.taken: {shortcut} is used by Windows or another app. Choose a different combination.
error.saveFailed: Couldn't save the setting. The shortcut is unchanged.

issue.noKey: Modifiers alone can't make a shortcut; add an ordinary key.
issue.unsupported: {key} can't be used in a global shortcut.
issue.lockKey: Caps Lock, Num Lock and Scroll Lock can't be part of a combination.
issue.needsModifier: A combination needs Ctrl, Alt or Win.
issue.reserved: {shortcut} is used by Windows or by most apps.
issue.taskManager: Ctrl+Shift+Esc opens Task Manager. To replace it, turn it on in Settings → Permissions.
issue.editing: {shortcut} is used for copy, paste and other editing.

privilege.desc: Lets a standard user perform privileged tasks such as managing system processes. Installing and removing require administrator permission.
privilege.statusDesc: Connects to the service automatically; each rule shows its result below.

state.busy: Waiting for administrator permission or working on the service…
state.unknown: Can't read the status right now
state.unreachable: Running, but can't connect right now

privilege.outdated: Service version {service} does not match GoodGood {app}.
privilege.incompatible: Click Update service to install the version matching GoodGood.

install.title: Enable the privileged service?

uninstall.title: Uninstall the privileged service?
uninstall.body: Windows Task Manager is restored first, then the background service is stopped and removed. If restoring fails, uninstalling stops. GoodGood keeps running, and actions on system processes and services are limited by its current permissions again. Uninstalling requires administrator permission.

privilege.uninstalled: The privileged service has been uninstalled.

taskManager.title: Replace Task Manager
taskManager.desc: Makes Task Manager shortcuts such as Ctrl+Shift+Esc open GoodGood.

confirm.title: Replace Task Manager?
confirm.body: Ctrl+Shift+Esc and other ways of opening Task Manager will open GoodGood. The change applies to the whole PC; other accounts still open Windows Task Manager. Turning it on requires administrator permission. If GoodGood fails to start, it attempts to open the built-in Task Manager. Keep the standalone recovery tool so the change can be undone if the interface or the service can't run.

taskManager.openNativeHint: Opens Windows Task Manager once and keeps the current replacement setting.
taskManager.openNativeFailed: Could not open Windows Task Manager: {error}
taskManager.restored: Windows Task Manager has been restored.
taskManager.retry: Refresh the status and try again.
taskManager.recovery: If the interface won't open, run the standalone recovery tool: {path}

window.title: Window transitions
window.desc: Fades the window when shown, hidden, minimized or restored.

ui.title: Interface animations
ui.desc: Page and dialog transitions, selection movement and icon animations.

chart.title: Chart animations
chart.desc: Higher frame rates make charts smoother but use more resources.

acceleration.title: Hardware acceleration
acceleration.desc: When off, the CPU draws. Use if the screen stutters while the GPU is busy.

data.intervalDesc: Shorter intervals give finer charts but make GoodGood itself use more resources.

minimized.title: Refresh rate while minimized
minimized.desc: Sampling interval while minimized; longer intervals cost less in the background.

tray.title: Refresh rate in the tray
tray.desc: Sampling interval while hidden in the tray; longer intervals cost less in the background.

releaseHidden.title: Free memory when hidden
releaseHidden.desc: After this time hidden, chart images are freed and memory returned to Windows.

netUnit.title: Network speed unit
netUnit.desc: Bytes match storage speed units; bits match link speeds and data plans.

history.title: Record history
history.on: Records usage every 5 seconds; data stays on this PC for 7 days.
history.off: Off. Existing records expire after 7 days, or can be cleared now.

confirm.title: Clear history?
confirm.body: All recorded history ({size}) will be deleted. This can't be undone.

rules.title: Set priority or efficiency mode when a program starts
rules.desc: Saved rules apply to running processes at once.

summary.noAction: Choose a priority or efficiency mode to apply.
summary.notSeen: The program hasn't been detected yet.

denied.one: Access denied for {count} process; enable the privileged service
denied.other: Access denied for {count} processes; enable the privileged service

failed.one: Couldn't apply to {count} process; check the privileged service status, then save the rules again
failed.other: Couldn't apply to {count} processes; check the privileged service status, then save the rules again

detail.ready: Installing requires administrator permission; GoodGood exits during it.
detail.portable: The portable version doesn't update automatically. Download the new version from the release page.
detail.source: Updates come from GitHub Releases; the signature is verified before installing.

auto.title: Check for updates automatically
auto.desc: Checks about 1 minute after startup and once a day; downloads in the background.

whatsNew.title: Show what's new after updating
whatsNew.desc: Shows changes once per version at the first open after an update.

channel.label: Update channel
channel.desc: Beta gets features sooner but may be less stable.

route.label: Download source
route.desc: The GitHub proxy is run by a third party and can see this PC's IP and downloaded files.

proxy.label: GitHub proxy
proxy.fallback: If GitHub is unavailable, this proxy is tried, then the built-in one.
proxy.only: All update requests go through this proxy.

custom.title: Custom proxy
custom.desc: A prefix added before GitHub URLs. Must use https.
custom.label: Custom proxy URL

star.title: Star reminder
star.desc: Shows the star request card once a day; turns off if you decline reminders.

about.tagline: A fast, modern, information-rich Windows task manager.
about.service: Running as a standard user. The privileged service is connected and carries out actions that need administrator rights.
about.standard: Running as a standard user. Information and actions for some system processes are limited.

onboarding.title: Welcome guide
onboarding.desc: Go through the essential settings and tips again.

license.title: License
license.desc: Free software under the Apache License 2.0, with no warranty.

notices.title: Third-party components
notices.desc: Open-source components included in GoodGood, with their licenses and copyright notices.

log.title: Log
log.desc: Logs error codes and file paths. Command lines and credentials are not logged.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostic information
diagnostics.desc: Copies version, run state, hardware and display settings.

sensors.title: Kernel sensors
sensors.desc: Checks PawnIO and installs the official driver if missing. Install the privileged service first.
sensors.preparing: Preparing the driver. Complete the administrator prompt.

administrator.development: Persistent administrator authorization is unavailable with development hot reload. Use a release build.
administrator.title: Run as administrator
administrator.restart: GoodGood restarts after switching, keeping settings and history.
administrator.afterOnboarding: Continue setup after authorizing. GoodGood restarts with the selected permissions when setup finishes.
administrator.standardAccount: No administrator identity, so automatic administrator startup is unavailable.

appearance.scaleDesc: Adjusts text, icon and control sizes from 80% to 150%.
appearance.fontDesc: Base font size is 11–20 px; headings and secondary text scale with it.
appearance.saveFailed: Could not save interface preferences. Check that the configuration folder is writable.
